brief: Distinguish a deduction from a credit using a fictional simplified calculation.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Tax Reductions"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "¿Reducir ingreso o impuesto?"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Reduzir renda ou imposto?"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Distinguish a deduction from a credit using a fictional simplified calculation.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A deduction and a tax credit change different steps in a calculation.
instruction.misconception: A deduction reduces tax by its full face amount in the same way as a credit.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: In this fictional rule, a deduction reduces taxable income first. A credit reduces the calculated tax afterward.
The deduction changes income; the credit changes calculated tax.
The deduction belongs before the rate calculation.
Tax applies to income remaining after the deduction.
The credit reduces the calculated tax directly here.
The shortcut puts the deduction at the credit’s step.
Apply the deduction before the rate and the credit afterward.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: A deduction and a tax credit change different steps in a calculation.

es-MX.line: Una deducción y un crédito fiscal cambian pasos distintos de un cálculo.

pt-BR.line: Uma dedução e um crédito fiscal mudam etapas distintas de um cálculo.

en-US.line: In this fictional rule, a deduction reduces taxable income first. A credit reduces the calculated tax afterward.

es-MX.line: En esta regla ficticia, una deducción reduce primero el ingreso gravable. Un crédito reduce después el impuesto calculado.

pt-BR.line: Nesta regra fictícia, uma dedução reduz primeiro a renda tributável. Um crédito reduz depois o imposto calculado.

en-US.prompt: Fictional rule: income 100 dollars; deduction 20; tax rate 10%; credit 3; Follow the order.

feedback.met: The deduction changes income; the credit changes calculated tax.
feedback.not_yet: Deduct from income first, then calculate tax and subtract credit.

help: Deduct from income first, then calculate tax and subtract credit.

es-MX.prompt: Regla ficticia: ingreso 100 pesos; deducción 20; tasa 10%; crédito 3; Sigue el orden.

feedback.met: La deducción cambia ingreso; el crédito cambia impuesto calculado.
feedback.not_yet: Deduce del ingreso, calcula impuesto y resta el crédito.

help: Deduce del ingreso, calcula impuesto y resta el crédito.

pt-BR.prompt: Regra fictícia: renda 100 reais; dedução 20; taxa 10%; crédito 3; Siga a ordem.

feedback.met: A dedução muda a renda; o crédito muda o imposto.
feedback.not_yet: Deduza da renda, calcule imposto e subtraia o crédito.

help: Deduza da renda, calcule imposto e subtraia o crédito.

en-US.scene: The fictional rule says a deduction reduces income before tax is calculated.
help: Follow the rule’s stated calculation order.

feedback.met: The deduction belongs before the rate calculation.
feedback.not_yet: Follow the rule’s stated calculation order.

es-MX.scene: La regla ficticia dice que la deducción reduce ingreso antes de calcular impuesto.

feedback.met: La deducción corresponde antes del cálculo con tasa.
feedback.not_yet: Sigue el orden indicado por la regla.

pt-BR.scene: A regra fictícia diz que a dedução reduz renda antes de calcular imposto.
help: Siga a ordem dada pela regra.

feedback.met: A dedução entra antes do cálculo com a taxa.
feedback.not_yet: Siga a ordem dada pela regra.

en-US.scene: Fictional income: 200; Deduction: 50; Tax rate: 10%. No credits.
help: Subtract the deduction, then apply the rate.

feedback.met: Tax applies to income remaining after the deduction.
feedback.not_yet: Subtract the deduction, then apply the rate.

feedback.met: El impuesto aplica al ingreso restante tras deducir.
feedback.not_yet: Resta la deducción y aplica la tasa.

feedback.not_yet: Subtraia a dedução e aplique a taxa.

en-US.scene: Fictional tax already calculated: 25; Allowed credit: 5; Subtract it directly under this rule.

feedback.met: The credit reduces the calculated tax directly here.
feedback.not_yet: Subtract the credit from the tax already calculated.

feedback.not_yet: Resta el crédito del impuesto ya calculado.
